content.summary: Research findings for: map Vercel AI SDK integration in packages/opencode/src

data.original_input: Exploration: Vercel AI SDK Integration in OpenCode. Map current usage, provider abstraction, Claude Agent SDK wrapper, streaming flow, and other providers using Vercel AI SDK.

details: Imports Vercel AI SDK Provider type from "ai" and bundles many @ai-sdk/* providers.
BUNDLED_PROVIDERS maps provider npm to create* functions (anthropic, openai, google, etc.).
getSDK builds provider options and instantiates SDK providers; getLanguage returns LanguageModelV2 instances used by streamText.
claude-agent-sdk is registered as a custom provider (sdk.languageModel).
Main streaming entrypoint uses streamText/wrapLanguageModel from "ai".
Calls Provider.getLanguage to get LanguageModelV2 for selected provider/model.
wrapLanguageModel middleware applies ProviderTransform.message and extractReasoningMiddleware.
Tooling uses ai Tool/ToolSet types; providerExecuted tool stub added for Claude Agent SDK tool execution.
Normalizes ModelMessage content, applies caching providerOptions, and remaps providerOptions key via sdkKey().
sdkKey maps @ai-sdk/* packages to AI SDK providerOptions keys (openai, anthropic, google, bedrock, gateway, openrouter).
providerOptions() wraps options under provider key expected by AI SDK.
Implements LanguageModelV2 from @ai-sdk/provider to adapt Claude Agent SDK.
doStream loads @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query(), translates prompt, builds MCP tool server, and returns AI SDK stream parts.
doGenerate reconstructs content/usage from stream parts to satisfy AI SDK expectations.
Converts Claude Agent SDK async stream events into LanguageModelV2StreamPart.
Handles tool progress/summary events and emits tool-call/tool-result with providerExecuted metadata.
Translates LanguageModelV2Prompt to Claude Agent SDK prompt format, including tool results and file parts.
Uses Claude Agent SDK createSdkMcpServer to expose OpenCode tools/MCP tools to the SDK.
Converts Zod schemas to SDK-compatible input schemas; tool execution routed through OpenCode ToolRegistry.
Custom provider implements LanguageModelV2 using @ai-sdk/provider; used for GitHub Copilot and openai-compatible endpoints.
Relies on @ai-sdk/openai-compatible and @ai-sdk/provider-utils.
Implements LanguageModelV2.doStream using AI SDK provider-utils and SSE parser to emit LanguageModelV2StreamPart.
Uses AI SDK error/types (APICallError, LoadAPIKeyError) and convertToModelMessages for message conversion.
Uses ai tool/jsonSchema/ToolCallOptions for tool definitions passed to AI SDK calls.
Maps MCP tools to AI SDK Tool via dynamicTool/jsonSchema.
Uses generateObject/streamObject from AI SDK for agent generation flows.
Uses LanguageModelUsage and ProviderMetadata types from AI SDK for session metadata.
Uses LoadAPIKeyError from AI SDK when surfacing auth issues.

prior_art: No .agents/messages learn packets or .agents/sdlc/done work items found in this repo.
patterns: LanguageModelV2 is the core provider abstraction across OpenCode; providers return LanguageModelV2 instances consumed by streamText.
Provider options are keyed by provider name per AI SDK expectations (ProviderTransform.sdkKey/providerOptions).
Tooling and message flow are modeled using AI SDK types (ModelMessage, Tool, ToolSet, StreamTextResult).
Claude Agent SDK is already wrapped to conform to AI SDK streaming and tool-call semantics via translate-* adapters.
raw_options: Add a feature-flagged LLM stream path that calls Claude Agent SDK directly and bypasses streamText (keep AI SDK elsewhere).
Introduce an internal model interface (OpenCodeLanguageModel) and adapt AI SDK and Claude Agent SDK behind it.
Replace streamText/wrapLanguageModel with direct SDK streaming and implement equivalent middleware (reasoning, tool repair).
Keep AI SDK and only tighten the Claude Agent SDK adapter to reduce dependency surface (status quo with improved isolation).
Spike a minimal shim that emulates streamText using LanguageModelV2.doStream to measure how much logic lives in AI SDK middleware.
